BL-1429 — Standing reds throttle intake: the throttle recommendation folds the standing-red register in, recommending a cap of 1 when the register holds more than 10 reds, an oldest red older than 7 days, or any unowned red (thresholds in swarmforge.conf), keeping the lower of its two recommendations, logging every change with its signal, and withdrawing it as soon as the register is back under every threshold (human directive and thresholds 2026-09-05)
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-05 by the specifier on the human's "go" (verbatim in
description). Second of the three pieces; the third was the constitution
and prompt amendments landed in the same commit (BL-798), see
`articles/reference/standing-red-register-amendment-2026-09-05.md`.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options; the thresholds are the ones you said "go" to (10 reds, 7 days, any unowned red, cap to 1). One consequence to be aware of: the r…
BL-1429 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1429" (or "reject BL-1429 <reason>") to act.
